analysis.summary: During the financial year 2024-25, Dev Labtech Venture Limited reported an increase in revenue from operations to Rs. 5,241.39 lakh from Rs. 4,322.24 lakh in the previous year, while net profit after tax decreased to Rs. 129.38 lakh due to lower profit margins against higher expenditures. Management highlighted strategic expansion into lab-grown diamonds through the purchase of MPCVD machinery and the incorporation of a wholly-owned subsidiary in Delaware, USA.

guidance.claim: The company stated that the year of commencement for the Vibrant Gujarat 2024 Summit proposed investment project will be 2026.
guidance.quote: The proposed investment is of Rs.102 Crore, Proposed Employment is 500, Proposed Project Location is Surat, Gujarat, India and year of Commencement will be 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the diamond industry is undergoing a profound transformation driven by consumer preferences, technological advancements, and evolving market dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: The diamond industry is undergoing a profound transformation, driven by shifts in consumer preferences, technological advancements, and evolving market dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that lab-grown diamonds are becoming an integral part of the diamond market as an alternative to traditional natural diamonds.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company is step up with the current scenario, the industry continues to adapt, lab-grown diamonds are set to become an integral part of the diamond market, offering a compelling alternative to traditional natural diamonds.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects business operations to report satisfactory financial results in the coming months with the anticipated V-shaped recovery in the economy.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite a challenging economy, considering company’s diversified quality product portfolio, long standing relationships and goodwill with its distributors, agents and direct consumers, suppliers and other stake holders, the business operations of the company are expected to report satisfactory financial results in the coming months with the V-shaped recovery in the economy expected by all of us.

capex_expansion.claim: A wholly owned subsidiary was incorporated under the name Dev Labtech Venture Inc. in Delaware, USA.
capex_expansion.quote: •Incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary under the name “DEV LABTECHVENTUREINC.”inDelaware,USA.

capex_expansion.claim: The company purchased an MPCVD machine for growing lab-grown diamonds.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has purchased MPCVD machine for growing of Lab Grown Diamonds.

capex_expansion.claim: The company signed an MoU in the Vibrant Gujarat 2024 Summit for an investment of Rs. 102 Crore in Surat for lab-grown diamond manufacturing, natural diamonds, and gems and jewellery.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has signed MOU in the Vibrant Gujarat 2024 Summit for the purpose of growth and expansion of the Business of the Company in the existing line of business of Lab Grown Diamond Manufacturing, natural diamonds and Gems and Jewellery Sector.

capex_expansion.claim: The company applied for a Solar Power Project of 1300 KV (DC) in GEDA for captive use in growing lab-grown CVD diamonds to reduce power costs.
capex_expansion.quote: Dev Labtech Venture Limited has applied for Solar Power Project of 1300 KV (DC) in Gujarat Energy Development Agency (GEDA) for the Captive use for Growing Lab grown CVD diamond.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has recently started manufacturing lab-grown diamonds, whereas it was previously engaged exclusively in natural diamond processing.
capex_expansion.quote: Our Company has recently started manufacturing of lab grown diamonds before that our company was engaged in processing of natural diamonds only.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit after tax decreased due to a decrease in profit margin against higher expenditure incurred.
margins_costs.quote: However, the Company’s Net Profit after tax has been decreased to Rs. 129.38 Lakh for the current year as against the Net Profit after tax of Rs. 134.13 lakh of the previous year due to decrease in profit margin against higher expenditure incurred.

margins_costs.claim: The company consumed 9,55,253 units of electricity costing Rs. 99.43 lakh and 9,240 liters of gas costing Rs. 16.45 lakh in the manufacturing process.
margins_costs.quote: Electricity Gas Unit Total Cost (Rs. In Lakh) Liters Total Cost (Rs. In Lakh) 9,55,253 99.43/- 9,240 16.45/-

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin slightly decreased from 3.36% to 3.10% during the year.
margins_costs.quote: The profit margin has slightly decreased from 3.36% to 3.10%, which might indicate increased costs or expenses despite the higher turnover.

margins_costs.claim: Declining rupee values created cost-bearing scenarios in raw material imports, while product prices were simultaneously increased to sustain the financial position.
margins_costs.quote: One of the troubling things about our performance in the recent past was that due to weaken economic condition and war situation, the rupee values goes down so it created cost bearing scenario, specifically in the raw materials including import, simultaneously we increased prices in our product portfolio, resulted to sustain financial position.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that all factories are gradually enhancing utilization and reducing dependency on outsourcing.
orders_capacity.quote: Now all factories are gradually enhancing utilisation and reducing our dependency on outsourcing.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors did not recommend any dividend on equity shares for the year in order to conserve resources and support future expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, in order to conserve resources and future expansion, your directors have not recommended any Dividend on Equity Shares of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company retained the entire amount of profit for financial year 2024-25 in the statement of profit and loss without transferring any amount to reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, your directors has decided to retain the entire amount of profit for financial year 2024-25 in the statement of profit and loss and do not proposed to transfer any amount to Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not recommend any dividend for the year under review due to a conservative policy.
capital_allocation.quote: Due to conservative policy adopted by the Company, your directors don’t recommend any dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued and allotted 3,592,000 share warrants convertible into equity shares on a preferential basis.
capital_allocation.quote: Further, Company had issued and allotted preferential basis 3592000 Warrants at Rs. 62/- per warrant (including a premium of Rs. 52/- per Warrant) convertible into 3592000 Equity Share of Rs. 10/- each to Promoter, Promoter Group and certain identified Non–Promoter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The past year was marked by geopolitical volatility and macroeconomic uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: Although the past year was marked by geopolitical volatility and macroeconomic uncertainties, which unfortunately resulted in tremendous suffering and humanitarian tragedies across various regions of the world, by staying true to our vision and remaining agile in our approach, we not only weathered the storms but also emerged stronger and more resilient.

risks_headwinds.claim: Economic constraints and the Russia-Ukraine war created supply chain challenges including raw material and transportation delays that affected production capabilities and timely deliveries.
risks_headwinds.quote: Although we face, various challenges due to economic constrain and Russia Ukraine war in supply chains, including raw material, transportation delays, affected our production capabilities and timely delivery to customers.

management_commitments.claim: The board approved material related party transactions with Dev Labtech Venture Inc. for a period of five years from FY 2025-26 to FY 2029-30.
management_commitments.quote: for an aggregate value of up to Rs. 50.00 Crores excluding applicable taxes for a period of five years from FY 2025-26 to FY 2029-30

management_commitments.claim: The company stated that the commencement year for the Vibrant Gujarat 2024 project will be 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The proposed investment is of Rs.102 Crore, Proposed Employment is 500, Proposed Project Location is Surat, Gujarat, India and year of Commencement will be 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Jerambhai Lavjibhai Donda was appointed as Chairman and Managing Director for a period of 5 years starting from September 24, 2022.
management_commitments.quote: He was appointed on the Board on April 29, 1993 and further designated as the Chairman cum Managing Director of the Company on September 24, 2022 for a period of 5 years, liable to retire by rotation.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Jay Jerambhai Donda was designated as Whole-Time Director for a period of 5 years liable to retire by rotation.
management_commitments.quote: He was originally appointed on the Board on April 18, 2011 and further designated as the Whole-Time Director of the Company on September 24, 2022 for a period of 5 years liable to retire by rotation.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
